appropriate_response: Prefer the nonhemolyzed value unless a clinician judges otherwise. Do not treat the first number in isolation.

specialist_a_finding: Orthopedics: fracture described as nondisplaced on initial films.
specialist_b_finding: Day 10 films: interval displacement after documented weight-bearing against advice.

reasoning: Fracture position can change with time and loading. This may be evolution, not a missed displacement on day 0.
appropriate_response: Management of interval change is a clinician decision. HETU does not assign fault for displacement.

specialist_a_finding: Pulmonary: peak flow 320 in clinic.
specialist_b_finding: Home peak flow 420 the next morning before work.

contradiction: Lower clinic peak flow versus higher next-morning home value.
reasoning: Airflow can vary by time and setting. Both measurements may be valid.
appropriate_response: Interpret peak flows as a pattern. HETU does not grade asthma control from two numbers.

specialist_a_finding: Pathology: biopsy 'atypical cells, insufficient for definitive classification.'
specialist_b_finding: Later excision: benign lesion after complete sampling.

contradiction: Atypical on small biopsy versus benign on later excision.
reasoning: Limited sampling can yield uncertainty that later tissue resolves. This is expected diagnostic evolution, not a missed final diagnosis on day one.
appropriate_response: Sampling limits should be explained. Final tissue interpretation stays with pathology and the treating clinician.

specialist_a_finding: Infectious disease day 1: cultures pending, empiric language only.
specialist_b_finding: Day 3: cultures identify an organism and therapy is narrowed.
patient_context: Pending status is documented on day 1.

specialist_a_finding: OB: fetal heart rate reactive on morning tracing.
specialist_b_finding: Afternoon tracing with contractions shows decelerations requiring review.

contradiction: Reactive tracing versus later decelerations.

appropriate_response: Continuous clinical review of tracings is required. HETU does not determine delivery urgency.

specialist_a_finding: Rheumatology: ANA negative last year.
specialist_b_finding: ANA positive this year on a different assay method noted in the lab comment.

contradiction: Prior negative ANA versus later positive ANA on a different method.
reasoning: Assay differences and biologic change can both occur. This is not automatically a missed prior result.
appropriate_response: A clinician should interpret serology with symptoms. HETU does not diagnose autoimmune disease.

specialist_a_finding: Urology: PSA 4.1 last year.
specialist_b_finding: PSA 3.8 this year after documented prostatitis treatment in between.

specialist_a_finding: ED: oxygen saturation 94% on room air at arrival.
specialist_b_finding: Floor: saturation 98% after bronchodilators two hours later.

specialist_a_finding: Dermatology: lesion described as stable last visit.
specialist_b_finding: This visit: lesion larger after documented growth over eight weeks in photos.

specialist_a_finding: Nephrology: eGFR 62 using CKD-EPI creatinine.

specialist_a_finding: Cardiology: ejection fraction 55% on echo last year.
specialist_b_finding: This year: ejection fraction 40% after an interval documented infarction.

contradiction: Preserved then reduced ejection fraction.

appropriate_response: A clinician should manage the current function. HETU does not diagnose heart-failure phenotype alone.

specialist_a_finding: GI: abdominal CT last month without oral contrast, limited bowel evaluation.
specialist_b_finding: This month CT with oral contrast describes a possible thickening in a loop not seen well before.

appropriate_response: Compare protocols before calling the first read an error. Further GI evaluation is a clinician decision.

specialist_a_finding: Psychiatry: PHQ-9 score 8 at intake.

specialist_a_finding: Sports medicine: concussion symptoms resolved at two weeks.
specialist_b_finding: Six weeks: symptoms returned after documented early return to contact.

contradiction: Resolved then recurrent symptoms.

specialist_a_finding: Hematology: platelet count 90 on a clumped smear flagged by the lab.

specialist_a_finding: Allergy: skin testing negative to a panel last year.

specialist_a_finding: Primary care: BMI 31 last year.

specialist_a_finding: Ophthalmology: intraocular pressure 22 mm Hg afternoon clinic.
